title: Anitabi Cross-Index
description: For every Bangumi subject in the anitabi-index L2 seed, the resolved AniList + MyAnimeList ids (or 'no_match'). Built by querying AniList GraphQL with the Bangumi Japanese title and disambiguating on episode count + start year.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference. Always set to this schema's $id.

generatedAt.description: Unix epoch ms when this build completed.

source.description: Identifier of the build script that produced this file.

seedSize.description: Number of L2 anitabi-index entries this build attempted to resolve.

entries.description: One entry per L2 seed. Sorted by bangumiId ASC for stable diffs.

bangumiId.description: Bangumi subject ID (the L2 seed key).

anilistId.description: Resolved AniList numeric ID, or null when no match.

malId.description: Resolved MyAnimeList numeric ID (from AniList's idMal), or null.

anilistPopularity.description: AniList's popularity score for the matched candidate.

anilistEpisodes.description: Episode count from AniList for the matched candidate.

anilistStartYear.description: First-air year from AniList for the matched candidate.

titleJa.description: Japanese (native) title from anitabi — used as the search key.

titleCn.description: Chinese title from anitabi (may be empty).

titleRomaji.description: Romaji title from AniList for the matched candidate.

titleEnglish.description: English title from AniList for the matched candidate.

matchType.description: How the candidate was selected. 'exact_native' = AniList native title equals anitabi title. 'top1_fallback' = no exact-native match, top search hit picked. 'manual' = override. 'no_match' = AniList returned 0 candidates or HTTP error.

matchNote.description: Free-text annotation explaining the match decision (e.g. 'unique_native', 'disambiguated_3_by_meta', 'http_error:...').

resolvedAt.description: Unix epoch ms when this row was last resolved (or last marked no_match).
